comment.text: PTPRS Y398 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Pancreatic tumors; Uterine tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
